title: Report a message
summary: Sends one message to the server team as a report, with an optional reason, and can block the sender in the same step.

senderName.description: Display name of the sender, for the block option.

reason.description: What the person writes. Can be empty.

alsoBlock.description: Block the sender too. Off at the start.

isSending.description: true while the report is sent.

error.description: true after a failed report. Shows bipe_app_report_error.

send.effect: Reports the message with the trimmed reason, then blocks the sender when alsoBlock is on, then closes and shows bipe_app_message_reported.

notes: Report and block stay in a DM (ADR 0141).
bipe_report_message_body says what the team receives: the reason and the message ID. In an encrypted chat the team cannot read the message text.
Blocking here is the Matrix ignore list, the same block as the profile. The block flow and its unblock bar are the people issue; this spec only calls it.
When the report is sent and the block fails, the report counts as sent: the sheet closes with bipe_app_message_reported, and the person can block from the profile.
